tools.name: find_walk_in_places
tools.description: Find businesses in a US city that take walk-ins, with how long the wait is right now. Open places come first, shortest wait first. Optionally narrow to one kind of business with `trade`: barbershops (barbershop), hair-salons (hair salon), nail-salons (nail salon), brow-and-lash (brow and lash studio

tools.name: get_place
tools.description: Details for one place from its `slug` (from find_walk_in_places): its address, whether it is open now, today's hours, the current wait and how many people are waiting, whether it takes walk-ins and online bookings, its team members, and the link to join the line.

tools.name: get_services
tools.description: The services a place offers publicly, with the prices and lengths it shows to customers (up to 30). Use a service's id with available_times, join_link or booking_link.

tools.name: available_times
tools.description: Open start times (up to 12) on one date for one service, when the place takes online bookings. Times are in the place's own time zone.

tools.name: join_link
tools.description: A link the person taps to join the place's line from their phone, optionally with a service and team member filled in. You cannot join for them: they confirm on the place's own page.

tools.name: booking_link
tools.description: A link the person taps to book an appointment, with the service (and optionally a team member and date) filled in. You cannot book for them: they pick a time and confirm on the place's own page.

tools.name: purchase_link
tools.description: The packages and memberships a place sells online, and the link where the person pays for them. Only for places whose owner turned it on. You cannot pay for them: they open the link and pay on the place's own secure Stripe page. Gift cards aren't sold online.
